decisions.reason: Although it received dedicated presentation early on, the schlager compilation CD is less central to the firm's specialist-curation identity and broader collector strategy, so weak later visibility makes it the easier commitment to unwind.

The illustrated music release series embodies the firm's curated, edition-led positioning and had visible multi-year promotion, which makes management more likely to justify and continue the commitment.

A reissued jazz vinyl LP closely fits the firm's reissue capabilities and stated genre-and-format broadening path, so disappointing initial traction can plausibly be treated as temporary niche-market underperformance.
The multi-disc box set likely involved substantial sunk production and editorial investment and aligns well with collector demand, encouraging escalation of commitment rather than withdrawal.
Because this compilation CD was only briefly mentioned and never strongly foregrounded, the firm has little public or resource commitment to defend and can drop it with minimal loss of face.
